about.bio:
I architect my own security ecosystems — transforming everyday devices into controlled environments for analysis and system re-engineering. My work spans from rooting and firmware alteration to adversarial simulation and defensive observation, bridging both offensive and blue-team mindsets.

I approach cybersecurity as an applied science: exploring system behavior through modification, exploitation, and reinforcement. My objective is to cultivate a deep, operational understanding of how digital infrastructures resist, adapt, and recover under pressure.

As a Software Engineer, I combine full-stack development expertise with automation and testing skills. I build scalable applications while ensuring they are reliable and efficient.
